newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Singapore PM Goh meets Hong Kong Governor Patten.
newsitem.headline: Singapore PM Goh meets Hong Kong Governor Patten.

text.p: Hong Kong's colonial Governor Chris Patten met visiting Singaporean Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong on Monday.
Both Goh and Patten declined to comment on their lunch meeting to reporters waiting outside the governor's residence, Government House.
Goh on Sunday met Hong Kong's future leader Tung Chee-hwa, who will head the territory's government after 156 years of British colonial rule ends at midnight on June 30.
Singaporean officials have released few details of Goh's Hong Kong trip, which follows a week-long visit to China that ended on Saturday.
